changeSet.author: mcpierce
changeSet.sql: UPDATE comic_pages_v4 SET comic_detail_id=(SELECT comic_detail_id FROM comic_details_v4 WHERE comic_details_v4.comic_book_id = comic_pages_v4.comic_book_id);
changeSet.createView: SELECT DISTINCT d.comic_book_id as comic_book_id, d.comic_detail_id as comic_detail_id, (SELECT reference_id FROM comic_metadata_sources_v4 m WHERE m.comic_book_id = d.comic_book_id) AS reference_id, d.filename as filename, d.archive_type as archive_type, d.comic_state as comic_state, d.missing as is_missing, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT * FROM comic_metadata_sources_v4 s WHERE s.comic_book_id = d.comic_book_id) THEN false ELSE true END AS is_unscraped, d.comic_type as comic_type, d.sort_name as sort_name, d.publisher as publisher, d.imprint as imprint, d.series as series, d.volume as volume, d.issue_number as issue_number, d.description as description, d.notes as notes, (SELECT RIGHT (CONCAT('0000000000', d.issue_number), 10)) as sortable_issue_number, d.title as title,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comic_pages_v4 cp WHERE cp.comic_detail_id = d.comic_detail_id) as page_count , d.cover_date as cover_date , CASE WHEN d.cover_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cover_date)) END as month_published , CASE WHEN d.cover_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cover_date)) END as year_published, d.store_date as store_date, d.added_date as added_date, d.last_modified_date as last_modified_date FROM comic_details_v4 d

SELECT DISTINCT p.file_hash, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cp.comic_detail_id) FROM comic_pages_v4 cp WHERE cp.file_hash = p.file_hash) as comic_count FROM comic_pages_v4 p WHERE p.file_hash IN (SELECT file_hash FROM comic_pages_v4 GROUP BY file_hash HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);
